settings.title: Organic and certified
settings.body: 8.9 oz organic combed ring-spun cotton fleece. GOTS, OCS, and GRS certified. The things on the label are the things in the hoodie.

settings.title: Made to be felt
settings.body: Heavyweight enough to feel like a hug. Brushed soft on the inside. Substantial in your hands before it's even on your body.

settings.title: 30-Day Guarantee
settings.body: If it doesn't feel right, I'll make it right. No questions, no restocking fee. Comfort you have to argue for isn't comfort.

settings.closing_quote: I made the thing I wished someone had sent me.
